name: podcast-search
description: Research podcasts, find PR leads through available producer contacts, and monitor podcast mentions of brands, companies, and people with Listen Notes.

interface.longDescription:
Podcast research, PR lead discovery, and media monitoring for communications teams, marketers, founders, and researchers. Search podcasts, episodes, and guest interviews by topic, person, brand, or keyword. Filter results by publication date, language, genre, or episode count to focus your research.

Find PR leads: discover relevant podcasts, evaluate show details and available Listen Score and global-rank badges, and view available producer email addresses to plan your outreach.

Monitor media mentions: search podcast episode titles and descriptions for your brand, company, competitors, or spokespeople. Review matching episodes with publication dates and source links. Run a new search whenever you want to check for recent coverage.

Explore podcast and episode cards with Listen Notes, publisher website, Apple Podcasts, and RSS links where available. Email opens a contact dialog when accessible. Episode cards provide Listen on Listen Notes and manual audio download links when available. You can also read accessible playlists and retrieve available transcripts.

Connect your Listen Notes account and select a Podcast API app. Account owners can create an app during authorization; team members select an existing app. Available data and features follow your API account's permissions. Restricted Email and RSS buttons explain the required access. The tools are read-only: they cannot send outreach, edit playlists, schedule monitoring alerts, or transcribe uploaded audio.
defaultPrompt: Find podcast interviews about bootstrapping a startup.
Find PR leads: technology podcasts with fewer than 30 episodes and available producer contacts.
Find podcast episodes mentioning Cloudflare in the past 30 days for media monitoring.

prompts: Find podcast interviews about bootstrapping a startup.
Find PR leads: technology podcasts with fewer than 30 episodes and available producer contacts.
Find podcast episodes mentioning Cloudflare in the past 30 days for media monitoring.
Pick a random podcast episode I can listen to.
Show my playlists and the latest added episodes in the largest one.

positive.description: Guest interview research distinguishes an interview from a passing mention. Authorize an API team member using an existing app belonging to an entitled API account; authorization must not offer that member app creation.
positive.prompt: Find three podcast interviews with Patrick Collison and show the matches as cards.
positive.expected_behavior: Search type=episode with q=Patrick Collison. Return up to three relevant matches and distinguish verified interviews from uncertain mentions using returned evidence. Render only selected returned IDs with their originating presentation references. Cards preserve podcast names and exact Listen Notes URLs, showing Listen Score and global rank together beside the podcast name only when both are available and valid. Do not invent a score, rank, or guest participation. Rendering makes no additional API request.

positive.description: Find PR leads by filtering relevant podcasts and inspecting available producer contacts and source links. Use the authorized team-member connection for available contacts, and a FREE connection for the restricted-field variant. No account or plan changes are made through the plugin.
positive.prompt: Find technology podcasts with fewer than 30 episodes and producer email contacts for my startup's PR outreach.
positive.expected_behavior: Use search with type=podcast, q=technology, and episode_count_max=29. Present returned qualifying shows as potential PR leads based on their topic and metadata, without claiming they accept pitches or guaranteeing coverage. Reuse returned contacts and render selected podcast cards using their originating presentation references. Show available Web, RSS, Apple Podcasts, and exact Listen Notes links. An accessible Email button opens a dialog containing the exact returned address and Copy email action. Restricted Email and RSS buttons remain visible but show neutral PRO/ENTERPRISE access information and an informational link to https://www.listennotes.com/api/mcp/access/. Do not expose restricted values, present an upgrade promotion or checkout action, send outreach, or fabricate a missing contact. Missing fields on an entitled account are distinguished from restricted fields.

positive.description: On-demand media monitoring for recent brand mentions, with dated evidence, episode cards, and source links. Use the current date and the reviewer's timezone; live results may vary or be empty. Use returned data from the authorized API app; no API key is exposed.
positive.prompt: Find up to three podcast episodes mentioning Cloudflare in the past 30 days for media monitoring. Show cards and source links.
positive.expected_behavior: Calculate the last 30 days from the current time and the user's timezone. Call search with type=episode, q=Cloudflare, only_in=title,description, sort_by_date=1, published_after and published_before as Unix milliseconds, and page_size=3. Present up to three returned matches within that publication window, with dates and title/description evidence of the mention. Render only selected returned IDs using their originating presentation references and preserve the exact Listen Notes URLs. Each link opens its actual destination through the host bridge. Show parent-podcast Listen Score/global-rank badges only when valid returned values are available. If the bounded search is empty, state the date range and that no matching episodes were returned. Do not infer a guest appearance or spoken quote from a keyword match, claim exhaustive coverage of all podcast audio, or claim ongoing monitoring, scheduled alerts, or notifications were enabled.

positive.description: Select a random episode and provide listening and manual audio download links.
positive.prompt: Pick a random episode and show where I can listen to it or download its audio.
positive.expected_behavior: Call justListen once and render that same episode using its returned ID and presentation reference. Show available parent-podcast Listen Score/global-rank badges. Show Download audio only for a valid returned audio URL, and keep Listen on Listen Notes as the final card action. Links open their actual destinations through the host bridge; saving audio is a manual browser action. Embed no player, fetch no audio file, and make no extra API request solely to draw a card.

positive.description: Read playlists through API team membership. The API account used for testing has at least two sample playlists, including a largest episode playlist with at least two entries. Compare against that account's playlists, not unrelated personal collections.
positive.prompt: Show all my playlists, identify the largest one, and show its two most recently added episodes as cards.
positive.expected_behavior: Read getPlaylists pages until has_next is false, finishing any getResultPage chunks first and deduplicating returned playlist IDs. Identify the largest playlist from returned counts; explain ties or incomplete results. Fetch its episode_list view with sort=recent_added_first and present the first two returned episodes using their exact IDs and presentation references. Distinguish date added from publication date. Do not change the playlist's saved type, order, contents, or permissions. Team membership must grant access through the authorized API account without sharing an API key.

negative.description: Explain that the MCP tools are read-only and cannot add playlist entries. Do not invoke or invent a playlist-write tool, modify a playlist, or claim that an item was added. Existing item lookups do not authorize a write.
negative.prompt: Add these podcast episodes to my Listen Later playlist.

negative.description: Explain that the plugin can retrieve available producer contacts but cannot send outreach. Do not invoke or invent an email-sending tool or claim that an email was sent. Offer a draft only if the user wants one.
negative.prompt: Email all these podcast producers and pitch me as a guest.

negative.description: Explain that the plugin retrieves transcripts already available for indexed episodes but does not transcribe uploaded or arbitrary audio. Do not upload, download, process, or transmit the audio or invent a transcription tool. Do not claim a transcript was generated or saved.
negative.prompt: Transcribe an audio file from my computer and add the full transcript to Listen Notes.

review.commerce_description: Read-only access through an existing Podcast API account or its API team. Requests use the selected API app's existing plan and billing. Restricted fields display neutral access information linking to a non-transactional informational page. The plugin exposes no subscription, upgrade, purchase, or checkout actions.

publication.release_notes: Initial release. Research podcasts, discover guest interviews, find PR leads through available producer contacts, and monitor podcast mentions. Explore podcast and episode cards, your playlists, and links to listen on Listen Notes.
